latest_release.name: v1.0.0 - "Fully armed and operational"
latest_release.body: > Now witness the power of this fully armed and operational ... system for managing agents and agent-like workloads securely at scale. Thank you to our MANY contributors who helped get us here! We couldn't have done it without you. :heart: ## What's Changed ### ⚠️ Breaking Changes * Envoy moves to v1.39.5, micro-VM assets to kata 4.3.1, kind and CSI images pinned by digest by @dims in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3181 * WorkerPools with similar long names no longer share a NetworkPolicy by @yufan-su in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3130 * MicroVM guests get their whole memory limit, and placement books each actor's runtime overhead by @BenTheElder in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3104 * Rename --cordon-control-plane to --cordon-system-infra-components and its node pool label to ate-system-infra by @haiyanmeng in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3210 * A microVM actor using more host memory than it booked no longer takes down its worker by @BenTheElder in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3429 * Remove the unused public MintActorCertificate API by @EItanya in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3427 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick #2392: Run containers as the image's USER and WORKDIR, with layer file owners kept by @BenTheElder in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3473 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick #3487: Unknown Linux capability names in an ActorTemplate are rejected at admission by @BenTheElder in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3514 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick 23 main changes through 4488a6667 by @EItanya in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3536 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick 19 main changes through 5a5b19219 by @EItanya in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3571 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick 21 main changes through fc931c4e2 by @EItanya in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3596 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick #3580: Restrict actor capabilities.add and make mounts nodev by @dberkov in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3611 * [release-1.0] Cherry-pick 5 main changes through 2289ade15 by @dberkov in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3645 ### Bug Fixes * atelet: detach Checkpoint from caller cancellation once underway by @chw120 in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/2602 * Actors can reach the network while they boot, before their wakeup probe passes by @QuentinBisson in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/2117 * atenet: classify a 403 route outcome as denied, not resume_error by @teemow in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/2534 * A gVisor actor going over its memory limit no longer takes down every actor on its worker by @BenTheElder in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3106 * benchmarking/nighthawk-egress: create namespaces in both deploy scripts by @ygao-g in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3315 * microvm: forward sysctls and lift the guest's privileged-port limit to match gVisor by @dims in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/1904 * Releases publish the envoy-dataplane image by @MushuEE in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3252 * atelet, ateworker: finish a checkpoint retry after atelet restarts by @chw120 in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3218 * ateworker: reuse a completed checkpoint only on the same boot by @chw120 in https://github.com/agent-substrate/substrate/pull/3213 * atelet:
